Description.SourceString:
Sturdy bolts of one of the most durable metals. Capable of piercing most armours with relative ease.

Have you considered what else those metal bars could be used for? You could create tools that would grow plants in these desolate lands. You could craft beautiful sculptures to bring joy to all who see them.

But, no, you went with murder spikes instead.

Though there are ruddy great dragons around the place, so I suppose it’s a fair plan.
